scope: Research-only DSP and trained neural reconstruction/local-learning modules; not a completed independent speech model or a strict clean-room implementation
implementation: New project code implements classical DSP, PCA/continuous controls, a two-layer neural waveform decoder and explicit local energy updates. No third-party neural model code or weights are incorporated in these modules; neural training audio is produced by existing Kokoro weights.
dependencies: NumPy/SciPy numerical primitives; optional Numba for scattering synthesis; SoundFile artifacts. Praat/Parselmouth performs offline pulse compilation and evaluation. WORLD/pyworld also supplies an explicitly external offline vocal-shape synthesis reference; speechbrain and local Whisper remain evaluators.
fixtures: Original sentences synthesized by existing Kokoro weights. Initial predictor weights fit only the two original synthetic reference clips; evaluation adaptation is labelled and delayed until observation. Not a clean-room speech corpus.

residualPolicy.fidelityBaseline: Original continuous residual retained; all ten measured clips PCM16 exact
residualPolicy.generatedExcitation: Decoder only sees continuous controls and optionally PCA source coordinates; original residual is unavailable
residualPolicy.coordinateOrigin: Encoded from existing input audio, not independently generated linguistic content

additionalMethods: Classical harmonic/noise oscillator, running reference harmonic statistics, and continuous PCA source coordinates; no codebook or global backpropagation.
acceptance: Generated excitation is lossy; naturalness and identity unaccepted. Existing Kokoro remains default.

currentResearchConfiguration.fit: PCA source model fits original synthetic references and stays frozen; explicitly labelled local predictors may adapt only from observed audio.
currentResearchConfiguration.latency: 15 ms lookahead, 25 ms ideal first-frame input buffering; sound device latency unmeasured

streamingInterface: voicebox_stream.ReferenceVoicebox: from_reference, push, finish, cancel. Target is processed incrementally; raw floats need caller playback gain/limiting.
comparisonLimits: Offline Praat oracle and speaker embeddings are evaluation-only; source-ceiling diagnostic is distinct from the runtime stream. Source descriptors and controls are still inferred from observed speech.

freeRunningControls.contextLeakageTest: Mutation of withheld PCM leaves every admitted analysis frame unchanged
freeRunningControls.training: Original two synthetic Kokoro references; adaptive variants may learn from observed evaluation audio only
freeRunningControls.acceptance: Not promoted; audio quality is inconsistent and longer gaps lose words

energyControl.method: Stationary harmonic/noise output-power estimate coupled to resonance; desired RMS is a continuous control
energyControl.limitation: Steady-state power is not a time-varying peak guarantee; direct-filter gap runs exposed four clipping failures

normalizedLattice.method: Classical normalized scattering rotations; normalized source-gain interpolation
normalizedLattice.zeroInputProperty: Stored state energy cannot increase solely from changing reflection coefficients; tested energy balance at sample resolution
normalizedLattice.scopeLimit: Does not guarantee bounded playback amplitude under arbitrary input, naturalness, independent content or biological learning
normalizedLattice.verification: Fixed-filter equivalence, chunk continuity, time-varying energy balance, zero-input energy, voicebox equivalence and invalid-state rejection

legacyCompatibility: Earlier measurements and saved source/predictor weights used LPC v1. Refit profiles for v2; archived implementation is legacy_lpc_v1.py.

neuralWaveform.teacher: Kokoro Heart and Michael synthetic speech
neuralWaveform.decoderInputs: 256 continuous target-encoded acoustic coordinates plus gain, every 10 ms; output duration
neuralWaveform.initialization: Batch PCA encoding and random tanh features with least-squares output fitting
neuralWaveform.refinement: One chronological local PC pass; no autograd/global backpropagation; mixed evaluation results

neuralOutputCandidate.scope: Output reconstruction only; input development deferred
neuralOutputCandidate.source: 20 synthetic Kokoro training clips, 4 development clips, 9 fresh evaluation clips
neuralOutputCandidate.hiddenFeatures: Coordinate-specific tanh units, batch fitted output layer

outputDetailRefinement.trainingTargets: Projection into the same teacher-fitted acoustic subspace; output-only loss ablation

performanceControls.algorithm: Classical pitch-synchronous overlap/add; new project renderer code, with offline Praat pulse analysis

analysisDependency.role: Offline pulse analysis during source performance compilation

performanceControls.controllerStreamingScope: Incremental PCM from a complete prepared control score; no growing score, live text or live control changes

vowelInstrument.approach: Sample-based captured voiced grains decoded by the frozen neural model; classical overlap/add with a new authored pulse schedule
vowelInstrument.source: Nine synthetic Kokoro prompts, three intended vowels across Heart/Michael/Bella

vocalShapeTransitions.scope: Continuous captured-vowel control paths; direct neural-grain crossfade and external WORLD spectral interpolation comparison
vocalShapeTransitions.shapeDescriptors: Median log spectral envelope and aperiodicity from short neural-decoded captured vowel patches
vocalShapeTransitions.worldRole: Explicit offline external comparator, not the independent neural generator

outputCapacityStudy.source: Same 20 synthetic Kokoro training clips and four development clips; six configurations retained
outputCapacityStudy.selected: 448 coordinates, seven tanh features per coordinate, ridge 1e-7

compiledNeuralInference.scope: Exact evaluation of eligible single-coordinate hidden units; unchanged frozen W/V weights, no pruning or fitting

streaming.stateScope: Two 240-sample neural overlap tails, 128 FIR state samples, at most 64 pending base samples; excludes weights, input controls and temporary arrays
streaming.timingScope: Warm resident compiled model branches and precomputed controls; excludes loading, compilation, control generation, live text, devices and transport

recognitionChanges.text: Dil over clouds are drifting softly, babe.
recognitionChanges.originalText: Dilver clouds are drifting softly, babe.

limitations: The neural decoders consume dense target-derived controls; no independent new words, notes or short-reference cloning is demonstrated by this fidelity panel.
Both branches use the same 20 synthetic Kokoro training clips; source-derived teacher weights are not clean-room provenance.
No global backpropagation is used; output layers are batch fitted, without a local predictive-coding improvement claim.
The prior SoulX lyric regression is removed, but a fresh score-adapter song has one normalized ASR change on an already misrecognized source phrase.
Singing reconstruction preserves an existing performance; source singing naturalness/identity are not thereby improved.
Objective fidelity gains and faster computation do not establish Kokoro-level perceptual acceptance.
The composition retains two neural networks; its input representation has higher bandwidth and is not a compact voice/phoneme model.
bandPreservingOutput.linearReferenceCaveat: Linear reference is both more accurate and faster on this reconstruction panel; neural reconstruction does not establish compact vocal control or new content generation.
bandPreservingOutput.runtimeInputs: Dense target-derived controls, two frozen decoders, 129-tap FIR; no original PCM or encoder basis at runtime
bandPreservingOutput.source: Both neural branches use Kokoro-derived training data; not an independently trained or clean-room voice engine

assembly.designOrigin: Add the richer decoder only above the 8 kHz boundary identified by the earlier error audit; motivated by capacity-v3 low-band/lyric regressions
assembly.scope: Two frozen target-control waveform decoders with a complementary FIR; no novel speech, compact articulator code or independent model provenance

compactVocalInstrument.method: Project harmonic-plus-noise synthesizer; neural decoder and external WORLD used only for offline profile capture; not a new neural vocoder
compactVocalInstrument.capture: Earlier frozen neural-decoded synthetic Kokoro patches; external WORLD spectral/aperiodicity analysis; fixed 96 cepstral + 8 noise + 1 RMS values per vowel

capturedHarmonicTexture.method: Fixed sinusoidal features, even-cycle least-squares fitting, captured harmonic amplitude and residual-phase interpolation
capturedHarmonicTexture.source: Nine earlier synthetic Kokoro vowel patches decoded with frozen v2 neural model; compact WORLD-derived noise/envelope reference unchanged

autonomousTexture.method: Three-dimensional PCA and ridge-fitted bounded linear transition, with stationary-covariance-calibrated Gaussian innovations; modulation of compact harmonic strengths
autonomousTexture.source: 30.85 seconds of new synthetic Kokoro repeated-vowel references, reconstructed by frozen v2 neural decoder before offline analysis
autonomousTexture.runtime: Captured compact profiles and learned statistical parameters; fresh independent RNG innovations, no recorded trajectory, PCM, pulse timings or future target audio
autonomousTexture.validation: Complete source segments held out with no analysis-support overlap; all short/quiet exclusions recorded

pulseBasis.method: Captured waveform mean plus eight PCA directions, bounded ridge-fitted transition and calibrated Gaussian innovations; causal overlap/add at commanded pulse times
pulseBasis.source: Nine Kokoro repeated-vowel recordings; frozen v2 neural reconstruction before capture; complete source segments held out with decoder-support guards
pulseBasis.runtime: Captured waveform templates, generated pulse coefficients and immediate pitch/vowel/gain controls; no recorded pulse sequence or future target waveform
pulseBasis.decision: Do not adopt pulse-basis variation as the quality default. A representation that reconstructs captured pulses is not enough: generated coefficients also need coherent excitation and accurate pitch. Inspect phase alignment and timing before expanding articulation.

phaseCanonicalPulse.method: Central-cycle extraction, source-band restriction and canonical fundamental phase; same frozen pulse banks and random state sequences
phaseCanonicalPulse.decision: Rejected: phase correction does not improve on periodization alone for spectrum matching and introduces a held-note pitch-tracker octave error.

liveNeuralGrains.runtime: Immediate 5 ms frames; frozen compiled neural waveform decoder with bounded lazy window caches; captured short-patch pulse microvariation reused

capturedArticulation.source: Nine fresh synthetic Kokoro words, with source-only quiet-edge trimming and late voiced-region selection
capturedArticulation.runtime: Frozen neural waveform decoder, recorded source voicing/pulse metadata and immediate 5 ms controls; captured onset and repeated nucleus
capturedArticulation.lexicalDiagnostic: Original words match intended sound class in 6/9 ASR cases; controlled neutral short/long words match 4/9. No pronunciation parity.

fixedCycleSustain.selection: Source-only spectral stationarity inside original pitch/energy eligibility and explicit short-condition sustain bound. Not phoneme recognition.
fixedCycleSustain.training: No new neural weights. Existing frozen neural decoder, source pulse analysis and captured synthetic units.
fixedCycleSustain.continuousControls: Immediate 5 ms pitch and gain; no runtime text or future score. Fixed 20 ms waveform delay.
fixedCycleSustain.generalization: Same nine development sources; fresh-source validation remains required.
fixedCycleSustain.pretrainedComparator: Existing attributed kokoro_singing.py adapter, offline pretrained Kokoro duration/pitch adaptation. Failed voicing/word checks; not a valid normal-Kokoro quality baseline.

freshSustainValidation.sources: 18 fresh synthetic Kokoro recordings; same three voices, six new unit words.
freshSustainValidation.frozenCoverage: 14/18 sources captured; all four failures counted.
freshSustainValidation.comparison: Same controller with frozen neural window decoder versus explicit lossless original-waveform frames. PCM reference is not an independent generator.
freshSustainValidation.result: Fixed-cycle ASR gain did not generalize. Single-word ASR also changes after quiet-edge trimming; no listening or identity acceptance.
freshSustainValidation.neuralTraining: No new neural weights or independent pronunciation model.

variableSpanCapture.scope: Post-validation development on four previously failed sources; all four recovered.
variableSpanCapture.change: Search source span endpoints as well as starts while retaining period-ratio, energy, pulse-count and 60–150 ms bounds.

pretrainedControlVoicebox.scope: Pretrained Kokoro per-utterance normalization-statistic ablation; no independent model or new training

savedStateReplay.scope: Replay all edited clips from saved acoustic controls and saved normalization statistics, without original speech-model inference

offlineDecoderTiming.scope: Resident pretrained model and prepared controls/source statistics; includes reference normalization hook and whole-clip decoder evaluation. Excludes loading, source-stat capture, control preparation, transport and devices. Not first-packet or streaming latency.

pretrainedControlVoicebox.decision: Retain the revised pretrained reference for listening and fresh-source validation. Interior-state holding and source normalization together yield fully tracked voiced sustains, but two octave disagreements and weak single-word ASR remain. This does not establish naturalness, identity or independent-engine parity.
pretrainedControlVoicebox.nextExperiment: Freeze the control-hold and normalization rules, test new vowels and source words, then evaluate whether these more stationary teacher references improve the independent waveform instrument. Keep pretrained synthesis, independent reconstruction and later control learning separate. Input understanding remains deferred.
limitations: All methods use the same requested duration/pitch and common interior analysis interval, but their onset/release timing differs.
New Kokoro controls are rendered as raw float WAVs; legacy references contain prior app filtering/level normalization. ASR is diagnostic, not a blinded quality test.
Single-word and sustained-tone ASR is unstable, including on original Kokoro audio.
No listening acceptance, general identity transfer or independent neural training is demonstrated.
Statistics come from each complete normal source utterance, not a generalized speaker embedding.
Only normalization statistics change relative to the prior control edits; captured controls and neural weights are unchanged.
This is offline full-clip decoding, not causal streaming or general reference cloning.
All hooks are restored in an isolated process; the app worker and installed source files are unchanged.
This is a source-derived adaptation of a pretrained model, not clean-room code or new neural speech-model training.
Normalization statistics depend on a complete source utterance and occupy 37,396 scalars per source; not a compact universal voice identity.
N is treated as an opaque acoustic control; it is not asserted to be a physical vocal-tract parameter.
No semantic audio input, general voice cloning, causal streaming or listener acceptance is demonstrated by this study.

freshPretrainedVowels.scope: Frozen fresh-vowel validation followed by a development ablation of the held pretrained feature stage

auditions.processing: Whole-clip constant gains, common measured level per source across all nine versions, 200 ms loudness gate. No limiter, pitch correction or denoising.

freshPretrainedVowels.decision: The earlier normalization improvement does not generalize reliably. Holding the later generator input improves voicing and word diagnostics on this same panel, but residual pitch disagreements and pronunciation failures prevent any quality acceptance. Retain as a labelled pretrained reference.
freshPretrainedVowels.nextExperiment: Isolate the 80 Hz sideband contribution from the harmonic source and subsequent generator layers, then test stationary references with the independent waveform instrument. Keep source selection, controller changes and neural reconstruction effects separate. Input understanding remains deferred.
limitations: The fresh protocol is frozen; the subsequent generator intervention is development on the same panel, not fresh validation.
Every synthesized clip still uses pretrained Kokoro weights. No independent waveform-generator training occurs in this experiment.
ASR on isolated sustained words is unstable: ordinary source words match only 11/18. It cannot establish perceived pronunciation quality.
Pitch pass thresholds are diagnostic (both trackers >=95% voiced, p95 error <=50 cents), not naturalness or identity acceptance.
Six raw samples in the upstream reference-normalization condition exceed full scale. Original float files are retained; audition gains avoid PCM clipping.
Per-utterance captured controls/statistics and offline whole-clip decoding do not establish general voice cloning or causal streaming.
Whole-clip compute timings exclude model loading, control preparation, source capture, transport and audio devices.

gainDiagnostic.scope: Constant gain in the steady core with guarded cosine ramps, calibrated to the uncorrected core RMS; no pitch correction or filtering.

outsideHoldBoundaryCheck.scope: Baseline compared to each candidate outside the hold plus a 200 ms guard; this does not guarantee unchanged audible joins.

auditions.processing: Constant whole-clip audition gains, matched per source across all nine versions with 200 ms loudness gating. No limiting, denoising or pitch correction. The separately labelled level condition already includes its experimental held-interior gain.

upsamplerGridAndGain.decision: The first upsampler contributes materially to the held-output 80 Hz sidebands: cancelling its constant-input phase response reduces them in 17/18 steady notes. Full cancellation also suppresses some vowel levels and shifts speaker embeddings. Offline held-gain compensation improves pitch/word diagnostics but does not restore baseline embedding similarity. Retain all conditions as controlled pretrained references; no quality default is promoted.
upsamplerGridAndGain.nextExperiment: Transfer the uncorrected and corrected/gain-compensated sustained references into the independent waveform instrument. Compare direct teacher output, independent reconstruction and immediate-control rendering with the same authored pitch and source intervals; retain pitch, identity and waveform-fidelity failures separately. Keep pretrained capture out of the runtime and input understanding deferred.
limitations: The panel is post-validation development on the same three synthetic voices and six words.
All teacher outputs still use Kokoro pretrained weights; this is not independent neural speech-model training.
Removing a periodic intermediate response can also remove useful voice detail. Lower sideband energy is not naturalness acceptance.
Gain compensation uses complete rendered audio and known hold boundaries, not a causal level controller.
ASR of isolated sustained words and ECAPA on singing/vowels are diagnostic; original teacher sources are imperfect baselines.
The transient feature hooks include CPU observation/correction and are not an optimized streaming implementation.
No perceptual identity, human-reference cloning or Kokoro-level independent output has been accepted.

independentSyllableTransfer.scope: Captured teacher waveforms transferred to a frozen independent decoder and onset/hold/release controller
independentSyllableTransfer.sourceAudio: Existing pretrained Kokoro controlled references; no Kokoro weights in independent rendering.
independentSyllableTransfer.runtime: Frozen axis-detail-v2 decoder with encoded waveform controls and offline pulse/release annotations; immediate 5 ms commands, fixed 20 ms delay.

capturedContextPreservation.scope: Preserve original decoded prefix, release or both around the unchanged retuned held vowel
capturedContextPreservation.sourcePanel: The same 18 corrected/gain-compensated synthetic sources; development ablation, not held-out validation.
capturedContextPreservation.runtime: Frozen independent decoder and captured unit, immediate pitch/release control; optional original decoded prefix/release around retuned hold.

heldGrainWindowAblation.scope: Held-grain window ablation with unchanged pulses, source spans, controls, prefix and release grain rules
heldGrainWindowAblation.sourcePanel: The same 18 corrected/gain-compensated synthetic sources; development ablation, not fresh validation.

playableLiveOutput.scope: Playable output from saved continuous acoustic controls; no new pronunciation generation

browser.scope: Browser automation with live monitor gain zero; no audible listening

checks.name: Held voice, mouse and keyboard notes, Finish word

limits: Saved dense acoustic detail is required; no compact learned articulators or new pronunciation generator.
No new training or validation source panel. Prepared speech streaming does not establish streaming generation from arriving text.
Individual local first-packet measurements exclude device latency; compute overruns occurred.
Playback fades mean the browser output differs at starts and stops from exact network samples.
No general short-reference cloning or singing naturalness acceptance. No human-like learning or predictive-coding result.
playableLiveOutput.nextExperiment: Assess natural new articulation transitions on fresh material, maintaining reconstruction controls and explicit source identity comparisons; collect listening evidence before claiming Kokoro output parity.

resonanceMorph.scope: Continuous spectral-resonance movement and a compact fitted timing curve, evaluated on eighteen new diphthong words

captureRepair.reason: Eight source periods yielded under 45 ms for all six higher-pitched development examples, leaving too few interior envelope frames. Retain at least 80 ms using pitch-adaptive pulse support before any held-out rendering.

runtime.excludes: Offline preparation, model loading, transport, browser buffering and devices; oracle probe is offline.

resonanceMorph.decision: Retain this as an experimental articulation controller. Moving resonances modestly improves spectral error over blending, but does not establish naturalness or identity. Fitted timing is not promoted. A full reference-envelope diagnostic improves spectrum and identity more, but remains far from direct reconstruction and loses pitch coverage.
limits: Every candidate receives target pitch, duration and RMS; this does not generate new pronunciation or prosody independently.
Endpoint data come from synthetic Kokoro development words. No general short-reference or human voice cloning evidence.
The nine-parameter curves are fitted spectral timing controls, not new neural phoneme learning or predictive coding.
WORLD envelope and Praat formant extraction are external offline analysis; runtime combines the existing neural decoder with project DSP.
The complete-envelope condition is a post-validation oracle diagnostic and must not be counted as independent generalization.
Six of eighteen natural teacher nuclei fail the same strict dual pitch gate; pass counts are diagnostics, not listening judgments.
Speech-trained speaker embeddings are uncertain on short vowel nuclei. Original and direct-reconstruction baselines remain visible.
Raw over-full-scale samples are preserved. Equal-RMS audition gains provide playback headroom without repairing the underlying amplitude control.
The 18 dB envelope-ratio clamp precedes energy normalization and is not a final waveform peak or frequency-response bound.
No audible listening acceptance; the user reported they have not listened yet.
resonanceMorph.nextExperiment: Using the same complete-envelope diagnostic, isolate phase changes introduced by the time-varying minimum-phase filter with a fixed-delay linear-phase alternative. Keep excitation, envelope and amplitude controls unchanged; separately inspect common carrier crest factor before any promotion.

wholeWordPlaybackCorrection.scope: Correct default widget behavior: complete natural words, explicit optional sustain
wholeWordPlaybackCorrection.userFeedback: The widget voice sounded fine; its indefinite mid-word hold was unwanted. This does not accept all A/B comparisons.

voiceCharacterControls.scope: Four additional output controls and explicit Kokoro source labeling
